title: Download one document from a bank portal postbox
description: Scrolls the postbox to the row whose text contains the given title, then presses THAT row's Download button and returns the file. The postbox shows one customer's mailbox at a time: the person or agent has to open the right mailbox (and tab) first. The portal marks a document as read when it is downloaded. Matched on any bank's domain by the portal's page metadata and the postbox path.

params.name: title
params.description: The document name as shown at the start of the row, e.g. "Kontoauszug 004/2025". Not the account number, not the date and not the whole row text: it is also matched against the Download button's accessible name, which words the account number differently.

steps.note: Scrolls the list to the row and clicks nothing: every row has its own Download button.
